question: What is the antonym of 'Ephemeral'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Eternal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Ephemeral"** means something that lasts for a very short time or is fleeting. (अल्पकालिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The beauty of a sunset is ephemeral, fading as soon as the sun dips below the horizon.
 
 
• **"Eternal"** refers to something that lasts forever, without any end, and is permanent. (शाश्वत)
 
 
• **Example:** The love of a mother for her child is often described as eternal.
 
 
• H
